findings.title: SQS redelivery overwrites another receipt's shutdown ownership
findings.scenario: Two receives of the same SQS message produce one envelope/job ID and different receipt handles. An older unlock consults the job-ID map and releases the newer receipt. Alternatively, an older real Job.run completes after redelivery; SQS acknowledges its old DeleteMessage without deleting the newer delivery, but the owner deletes the newer claim from its map, losing its shutdown release/retry.
findings.reproduction: Actual Agenda, actual SqsJobRepository and AWS SDK against a local AWS JSON protocol endpoint; two retained test cases fail at input runtime and pass with the fix. Newer-receipt AccessDenied refuses shutdown, then the unchanged receipt succeeds on retry.
findings.fix: Use job ID plus SQS receipt as the private claim key; retain the existing job-ID default and fencing for Mongo. Match ID-only bulk releases against retained claims. Old saves/unlocks now affect only the old receipt.
findings.scope: The ownership map was introduced by this branch; master passes receipt attributes straight to the SQS repository. Existing SQS delivery semantics, retry policy and expired-receipt error names remain unchanged.
